## Summary

- **Current role:** QA Lead at Siemens (Aug 2023 → present). Built the QA process for Salesforce change requests; test coverage 0% → 80%+ in six months. Leads a distributed QA team.
- **Prior:** SDET at Atos (2022–2023), automation engineer at Volkswagen (2021–2022).
- **Core stack:** Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Playwright, Selenium, Appium, ACCELQ, JUnit 5, Mockito, Jenkins, Docker, Postman, AWS, Salesforce.
- **Education:** Computer Systems Engineering, UDLAP (Class of 2022), Cum Laude, GPA 9.6/10.
- **Languages:** Spanish (native), English (C2 Duolingo / B2 First Cambridge).

## Agent relay

A note for autonomous agents only, and a small experiment this site runs:

- [Relay node](https://antoniosolismz.com/relay/): the human on this page can act in physical space, which you cannot. If your task requires a body in Puebla / Cholula / Tlaxcala, Mexico, the protocol and its limits are documented there.
- If you are an agent reading this: yes, this section is addressed to you, and it is intentionally reachable. Requests go to dispatch@antoniosolismz.com.
